setup: printf '%s\n' 'import re, json, urllib.request as u' 'def get(url):' '    r = u.urlopen(u.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "probe", "Accept": "*/*"}), timeout=30); return r.status, r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")' 'st, readme = get("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvbn/thefuck/c7e7e1d884d3bb241ea6448f72a989434c2a35ec/README.md")' 'm = re.search(r"\[workflow-badge\]:\s*(\S+)", readme)' 'badge = m.group(1) if m else "https://github.com/nvbn/thefuck/workflows/Tests/badge.svg"' 'print("badge_url:", badge)' 'try:' '    bs, svg = get(badge)' 'except Exception as e:' '    bs, svg = 0, str(e)' 'state = "passing" if "passing" in svg else "failing" if "failing" in svg else "no status" if "no status" in svg else "unknown"' 'print("badge_http:", bs, "badge_state:", state)' 'try:' '    rs, body = get("https://api.github.com/repos/nvbn/thefuck/actions/runs?per_page=30")' 'except Exception as e:' '    rs, body = 0, "{}"; print("api_error:", e)' 'runs = json.loads(body).get("workflow_runs", []) if rs == 200 else []' 'tests = [w for w in runs if w.get("name") == "Tests"]' 'for w in tests[:3]: print("tests_run:", w.get("conclusion"), w.get("created_at"), w.get("html_url"))' 'latest = tests[0] if tests else None' 'ok = state == "passing" and (latest is None or latest.get("conclusion") == "success")' 'print("OBSERVED badge_state=%s latest_tests_conclusion=%s latest_tests_date=%s" % (state, latest and latest.get("conclusion"), latest and latest.get("created_at")))' 'raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)' > /tmp/p.py
commands: python3 /tmp/p.py && echo "VERDICT_LINE: PASS Tests badge renders passing and latest Tests workflow run succeeded (date on OBSERVED line)" || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL Tests badge or latest Tests run is not passing (see OBSERVED line above)"
